FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 325
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Bobby D. Singleton
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/10/2026
Senate Bill 325 as introduced would codify the existing exemption of the Alabama Industrial
Development Training Institute (AIDT) from the contract review requirements of the Legislative
Contract Review Oversight Committee.
Also, this bill would exempt AIDT from compliance with the state procurement law for the
procurement of supplies and services, which, could increase or decrease the obligations of AIDT
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in (1) the cost of goods and services
procured pursuant to this bill; and (2) the cost procured otherwise under current law.
